hooks.command: FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx eslint --max-warnings=0 "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -8; fi

FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [[ "$FILE" == */migrations/*.sql ]]; then echo '⚠️  New migration: remember to add isolation tests in tests/isolation/ for any new tenant-scoped tables.'; fi
